title.zh: Kibo UI · 适合在 React + sh

description.zh: 具体条目内容细节展示。 Kibo UI 是面向 shadcn/ui 的开源组件注册表，首页可浏览 41 个组件、28 个 Blocks 和 1101 个 Patterns。组件页列出 Color Picker、Image Zoom、QR Code、Code Block、Dropzone、Marquee 等，并给出 npx kibo-ui add 安装命令；Blocks 提供 Form、Roadmap 等预组合区块。

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Kibo UI (https://www.kibo-ui.com/).
Technology stack: react, typescript, tailwind, radix-ui.
Component specification: 具体条目内容细节展示。


Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
